register.name: Registration in steps
register.description: This step-by-step form that works as a registration for a freelance user page, uses React as a framework, CSS to style the app skeleton, and some MUI Material components.

card.name: Challenge Card
card.description: This is my second Frontend Mentor challenge, I chose a basic card that took me approximately 2 hours. I used react as framework, styling the components with css. On this occasion I took the opportunity to use the Vite compiler, it was a fast and agile experience for me.

landingPage.name: Landing page Freelance
landingPage.description: This sample landing page was created for a client working as a freelance. It is completely customized by css, using libraries like fontAwesome, using React as a framework.

news.name: News Challenge
news.description: FrontEnd Mentor Challenge in which I was able to put into practice my knowledge of Bootstrap React, the management of its grid tools, and responsive design. It is developed with React, Vite and CSS to style some components.

bio.name: Professional Portfolio
bio.description: Developed with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion, this site offers smooth navigation and an elegant interface that highlights creativity and experience.

empowerit.name: Web Development for EmpowerIT
empowerit.description: Design and development of the EmpowerIT web platform, optimizing the user experience with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and animations with Framer Motion. A modern, dynamic, and responsive site that reflects the company's technological innovation.

okinawa.name: Web Development for Okinawa HealthTech
okinawa.description: Creation of the Okinawa HealthTech website, an innovative platform in the healthcare and technology sector. Implemented with Next.js, MaterialUI, and CSS, ensuring a modern, smooth, and optimized interface for the best user experience.

laburar.name: Final UX/UI Project – Digital Xperts (Codo a Codo 2024)
laburar.description: Group project developed in the UX/UI course at Codo a Codo 2024, where we designed a digital platform focused on improving user experience. We used Figma for prototyping and design, applying principles of accessibility, usability, and user-centered design.
